about_the_game:
Bolster your adventures and renew the strength of The Resistance with the Tinkerers Of Fate Character Pack!

Arcane artistry is on full display as we introduce two new crafty playable characters - the Toymaker and the Fortune Teller. These characters bring a host of new content to Fahrul to aid you in your journey - new weapons, a new trait, a new merc, and more!

The Toymaker is guided by their nimble hands and arcane influence. On the battlefield, their unhinged stare is a window into a fractured mind. An artist that blurs the line between brilliance and madness, the Toymaker is a talent-based character that captures the essence of their enemies into a child’s toy. These creations look intended for the entertainment of children; however, these tortured souls can be summoned into battle to do the bidding of their maker.

The Fortune Teller is a mischievous trickster shrouded in mystery. Moving with grace, confidence, and arrogance, the Fortune Teller has the ability to alter fortune and fate in the palm of their hands. Wielding elite-level awareness, the Fortune Teller controls fate through their tarot cards. Just as the fates decide, their alignment knows no equal and the outcomes of these tarot cards can alter the fortunes of Fahrul.

Whether you are manipulating destiny or meddling with dangerous devices, fate just got a little stranger.

For The King II: Tinkerers Of Fate Character Pack includes:

Two New Playable Characters

  • Toymaker

  • Fortune Teller

New Weapons

  • Rapier Set

  • Orb Set

New Content

  • Gold-tier Trait

  • Gold-tier Merc

  • Gold-tier Pet

Cosmetic

  • Gold-tier Cosmetic Skin

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400) or equivalent / AMD FX-8350 (4 * 4000) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 960 (4 GB) / Radeon RX 550 (4 GB)
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K (4 * 4000) or equivalent / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X (4 * 3500) or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 Super (8 GB) / Radeon RX 5700 XT (8 GB)
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
